data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.question: ability
sections.summary: A natural or learned skill that makes it possible to do something well.

senses.definition: a natural or learned skill or talent that makes it possible to do something well or effectively
examples: The children showed great ability in art and music.

answers.answer: She has the ability to learn languages quickly.

sections.question: ambition
sections.summary: A strong desire to achieve success, power, or a particular goal.

senses.definition: a strong desire to achieve success, power, fame, or a particular goal in life
examples: From a young age, she had ambition to become a scientist.

answers.answer: His ambition is to become a doctor.

sections.question: aspiration
sections.summary: A strong hope or desire to achieve something important in the future.

senses.definition: a strong hope or desire to achieve something important, usually referring to a career or life goal
examples: Her aspiration is to work for an international organisation.

answers.answer: Her aspiration is to start her own business.

sections.question: assurance
sections.summary: A confident statement that something will happen or is true; a promise or guarantee.

senses.definition: a confident statement intended to make someone less worried; a promise or guarantee that something is certain
examples: The manager gave assurance that the project would be completed on time.

answers.answer: He gave me assurance that everything would be fine.

sections.question: background
sections.summary: A person's past experience, education, family, and social history.

senses.definition: the facts about a person's family, education, and past experiences that have shaped who they are
examples: Candidates from all backgrounds are welcome to apply.

answers.answer: She comes from a musical background.

sections.question: behavior
sections.summary: The way a person acts or conducts themselves in a particular situation.

senses.definition: the way in which a person acts or conducts themselves in a given situation; the way someone behaves towards other people
examples: Good behavior is expected from all students during lessons.

answers.answer: His behavior in class was respectful.

sections.question: character
sections.summary: The combination of qualities and values that make a person who they are.

senses.definition: the combination of qualities and moral values that makes a person unique and defines who they are
examples: Her strong character helped her overcome many difficult challenges.

answers.answer: Honesty is an important part of her character.

sections.question: conduct
sections.summary: The way a person behaves, especially in relation to accepted social or professional standards.

senses.definition: the way a person behaves, particularly in relation to moral or professional standards; behaviour in a formal context

sections.question: confidence
sections.summary: A feeling of certainty and trust in your own abilities.

senses.definition: a feeling of certainty and trust in your own abilities or qualities; belief in yourself and what you can do

sections.question: eagerness
